# Codex App Server protocol schemas

These files are unmodified stable JSON Schema artifacts generated by
`codex-cli 0.147.0` with:

```text
codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <temporary-directory>
```

The generator was run without `--experimental`. Only the transport envelopes,
requests, responses, and notifications used by the AI Debates integration are
vendored. Runtime validation lives in the deliberately narrower Zod schemas in
`src/main/providers/codex/codex-events.ts`.

Authoritative protocol documentation:
https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server

The SHA-256 values in `SHA256SUMS` make accidental edits to generated artifacts
detectable.
